没有收到新事件不会改变成员的执行状态。: A lack of new events does not change an agent's execution state.
工具状态仅描述本次调用，不代表成员的执行状态。: Tool status describes this invocation only; it does not indicate the agent's execution state.
缓存和推理为细分项，不额外叠加到总量。: Cache and reasoning are breakdowns of the total and are not added again.
此快照中没有该记录: This record is not in the snapshot
跟随真实执行，读懂成员之间的协作。: Follow real execution and understand how agents work together.
请在 XY Switch 桌面程序中打开 Agent 编队，读取本地客户端的真实: Open Agent Fleet in the XY Switch desktop application to read real events from local clients. Browser previews do not connect to local observation sources.
读取本地事件后，成员、协作关系与任务会出现在这里。: Agents, collaboration links, and tasks will appear here after local events are read.
费用估算截至快照时刻；实际费用仅展示来源明确报告的值。: Cost estimates are calculated as of the snapshot time. Actual costs are shown only when explicitly reported by the source.
刷新间隔 30 秒；事件通知触发增量刷新。: Refreshes every 30 seconds; event notifications trigger incremental updates.
每一帧均由后端按事件投影；等待当前快照后继续播放。: Each frame is reconstructed from events by the backend. Playback continues when the current snapshot is ready.
观测数据不包含 CPU / 内存采样。: Observation data does not include CPU or memory samples.
调整状态或搜索条件以查看其他任务。: Change the status or search filters to view other tasks.
事件读取失败，保留已加载记录。: Could not read events. Previously loaded records are retained.
有新事件，刷新列表: New events available; refresh the list
当前范围没有事件。: No events in the current range.
搜索成员名称、角色或 ID: Search agent name, role, or ID
缩小概览，放大查看完整节点信息: Zoom out for an overview or zoom in for full node details
拖动节点调整位置；拖动画布平移；Ctrl / ⌘ + 滚轮缩放。: Drag nodes to reposition them; drag the canvas to pan; Ctrl / ⌘ + scroll to zoom.
方向键平移，+ / − 缩放，0 适应画布。: Arrow keys to pan, + / − to zoom, 0 to fit the canvas.
